description:
`knowledge.page.written@2`: a knowledge page's row and edges were
restated from its body — by `oxplow.knowledge.write_page` / `link` /
`resync`, or by the wiki watcher after a hand edit
(`system:wiki_watch`).

outbound.description: Every ref the page now points at (`oxplow:oxplow/file?path=src/lib.rs`, `oxplow:oxplow/wiki?slug=x`, …).

snapshot.description: The snapshot its new refs are pinned to, when there is one.

title: KnowledgePageWrittenV2
